current_grouping: Subpart G – Operating Limitations and Information

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G – Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text:
(a) The flap extended speed VFE must be established so that it is
  (1) Not less than the minimum value of VF allowed in USAR.345 (b); and
  (2) Not more than VF established under USAR.345 (a), (c) and (d).
(b) Additional combinations of flap setting, airspeed and engine power may be established if the structure has been proven for the corresponding design conditions.
